# Coding 0.6.2

This release adds the first Windows build of Coding.

## Windows

- Windows x64 installer built with NSIS.
- Git for Windows Bash is detected from standard system and user installation
  locations, Scoop, or Git on `PATH`.
- `CODING_GIT_BASH_PATH` can select `bash.exe` for a custom Git installation.
- Shell commands run with Git Bash path semantics, including converted Windows
  workspace paths.
- Foreground commands, background tasks, and the desktop sidecar stop their
  complete process trees when cancelled or when Coding exits.

## Downloads

Windows users need Git for Windows. The Windows installer is not code-signed, so
Microsoft Defender SmartScreen may show a warning.

DMG and ZIP builds remain available for Apple Silicon (`arm64`) and Intel
(`x64`) Macs running macOS 12 or later. The macOS builds are ad-hoc signed but
are not signed with an Apple Developer ID certificate or notarized.
